complete_degree_scope: N=5q, q>5 prime, arbitrary binary square fixed-phase masks
full_mask_boundary: d=N gives R=all ones; s=0 has empty invertible inverse-row class
statement: For q>5 prime, N=5q and any primitive complex Nth root zeta, a binary N-by-N mask R with D[r,c]=R[r,c]*zeta^(r*c) has either scalar Gram dI for some R exactly when d is in {0,1,5,q,5q}.
zero_mask_boundary: d=0 gives R=0; s=N is vacuous with M=F and error 0
